packageRules.description: Never try to bump privacytracker's own published image referenced in the deploy compose files.

customManagers.description: The Dockerfile bootstraps pnpm from ARG PNPM_VERSION, which must stay in lockstep with `packageManager` in package.json and the pnpm/action-setup pins in the workflows. Treat it as the npm `pnpm` package so the same bump lands in the same grouped non-major PR — without this it drifts (PR #125 moved everything to 11.12.0 while the ARG stayed 11.1.2).
